about_the_game:
Room 0 is a mind-bending exploration and puzzle experience where nothing is as simple as it seems.

You wake up in an ordinary room - Room 0 - and are invited to reach the exit. With each corridor you cross, you enter an alternate version of Room 0, shifting in atmosphere, rules, and logic. Behind this endless sequence of identical doors lies an invisible system waiting to be uncovered.

In this game, progression is not about collecting keys or skills, but about the knowledge you gain through observation, experimentation, and deduction. The place itself is the puzzle, and every room hides a clue.

  • A looping labyrinth, where backtracking does not always mean returning.

  • Strange and unique rooms that challenge your expectations.

  • A “knowlegevania” design, where progress comes through understanding, not items.

  • A clear yet elusive goal: find the true exit.

Every discovery shifts your perspective. Every realization brings you closer to the truth.
The exit is there - if you can understand how to reach it.
